fusions.name: Wayfarer's Pulse
fusions.desc: Sends a sonic pulse that deals 4 resonating damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and gains 5% damage per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 25%. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Marching Cry
fusions.desc: Sends a shriek into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 resonating damage. Your party deals 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 12 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Mending Miles
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
